zh.title: 交通部民航局宣布雙十節離島航線第二波加班機9月1日開放訂位
zh.summary: 交通部民航局公布雙十節離島航線第二波加班機9月1日9時起開放訂位
body: 交通部民用航空局表示，為回應雙十節返鄉及旅遊高需求，今年離島航線已於8月10日開放正班機及第一波加班機訂位，並計畫於9月1日（週二）上午9時起統一開放第二波加班機訂位，以擴增離島航線座位供應，確保旅客能及時購買機票。
其中澎湖航線提供1,016個座位，金門航線提供2,528個座位，總計提供3,544個座位，涵蓋澎湖、金門及馬祖三條離島航線，讓旅客有更多選擇以應付節日期間的高流量。
旅客必須在航空公司規定的開票期限內完成訂票，逾期將無法購買，以確保自身權益不受侵害，亦有助於航空公司更有效規劃加班機運能。
相關機票於10月8日至10月10日及10月10日至10月12日之峰段，將加註「限當日當班次」與「逾期作廢」使用限制，並採分級退票費用制度，最高可收取票面價的10%至30%不等。
此次安排旨在加速清艙作業並讓旅客能及時購買機票，確保雙十節期間離島航線運行順暢，亦有助於航空局掌握旅客訂位情形以便後續規劃加班機運能。
雙十節是台灣國人返鄉及旅遊的高峰期，離島航線自8月10日開放正班機及第一波加班機後，旅客需求持續攀升，為了因應此趨勢，民航局決定增派第二波加班機並擴大機型，以提供更大容量的座位供旅客選擇。
相關聯絡電話為02-2349-6041，聯絡人為邱美珍科長，民航局呼籲旅客依期完成開票，以免因逾期而失去票務資格。

en.title: CAA Taiwan Announces Second Wave of Overtime Flights for Double Ten Islands, Booking Opens Sep 1
en.summary: CAA Taiwan announces second wave of overtime flights for Double Ten islands, booking opens Sep 1
body: CAA Taiwan announced that, in response to the high demand for returning home and traveling during the Double Ten holiday, the second wave of overtime flights for island routes will open for booking on September 1 (Tuesday) at 9 AM, expanding seat capacity to meet passenger needs.

Penghu route offers 1,016 seats, Kinmen route offers 2,528 seats, totaling 3,544 seats, covering the Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu island routes to give passengers more choices for the high‑volume holiday period.

Passengers must complete ticket purchases within the airline’s ticketing deadline; tickets purchased after the deadline will be unavailable, protecting passenger rights and helping the airline plan overtime flight capacity more efficiently.

Tickets for the peak periods (October 8‑10 and October 10‑12) will be marked with ‘limited to that flight’ and ‘void after date’ restrictions and will be subject to a tiered refund fee schedule, with fees up to 30% of the fare.

This arrangement aims to speed up cleaning operations, allow passengers to purchase tickets promptly, ensure smooth island route operations during the Double Ten holiday, and help the Civil Aeronautics Administration monitor booking trends for future flight planning.

The Civil Aeronautics Administration reminds travelers to complete ticket purchases within the airline’s ticketing deadline to safeguard their rights, and provides the contact number 02-2349-6041 with contact person Chief Engineer Qiu Mei‑zhen for any inquiries.

The second wave of overtime flights is intended to alleviate the high passenger volume expected during the Double Ten holiday, ensuring that island residents can travel home smoothly while the administration monitors demand to adjust future flight capacity.
